items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: You know how many records they got of Oscar Peterson. And they are good piano players.

ctx.x: You know, I got to tell you something about this. When we went there, we had this German promoter and he did all the translating. He says, "Now, all of these fellas are Germans and they don't speak any English. But they all are finished concert pianists." So if you notice, they love piano. You know how many records they got of Oscar Peterson. And they are good piano players. He said, "They're hip music-wise, but they can't talk." So he says, "I'll do all the translating." We say, "Okay." So we were going…
know, just -- so when we get through and we run through it, he say, "Wait a minute, wait a minute." It was such a surprise. Everybody says, "I thought he couldn't talk."
